name: bcell_markers
default_raw: **7** (CD19, CD79A, MS4A1, BLK, VPREB3, FCRL1, PAX5)

name: angle_centroids
default_raw: **GC = mean(BATF, BACH2, PAX5); Plasma = mean(IRF4, IRF8); anchor = B-cell centroid**

name: n_genes_per_domain
default_raw: **~320** (intersection of model vocab and regulatory DB)

name: target_biological_system
range_raw: Intercellular communication (H38), cell cycle, metabolic state, spatial, immune activation

name: n_permutations
default_raw: at least 2000 (source paper does not specify exact n)

name: phase1_null_branch_required
default_raw: **true** — paired biologically-nonsensical branch must fail the same gates

name: let_alpha_reconstruction_weight
default_raw: source paper does not specify exact value

name: let_beta_distance_scale
default_raw: source paper does not specify exact value

name: scgpt_layers
range_raw: any subset of 0–11; paper uses layer 9

name: l1_coef
range_raw: 1e-4 to 1e-2; watch recon MSE vs `frac_active` tradeoff

name: annotation_databases
default_raw: **GO BP, KEGG, Reactome, STRING≥700, TRRUST v2**

name: leiden_resolution
range_raw: {0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0} per `b2_pmi_and_leiden_sweep.py`; stability via ARI vs 1.0 baseline

name: reference_graph_shared_genes
default_raw: **≥ 3** shared genes in GO BP terms

name: mps_fallback_env
range_raw: required for some ops on MPS

name: downstream_layers
range_raw: subset of layers with trained SAEs

name: ablation_conditions
default_raw: **{A, B, C, AB, AC, BC, ABC, clean}** (7+1)
